authorship: Original authored Minecraft cuboids and pixel atlas; Hunter-inspired cosmetics.
sourceLimits: No extracted mesh, texture, player skin, or animation data used.
No official Bungie asset, replica accuracy, or player-skin matching claim.
Skill Ace/Izanagi study used for clean volumes and explicit face UVs only.
Static curled cosmetic pose; named finger segments are not animated bones.
Offline preview is not evidence of native pack load, contact, or performance.

design.identity: compact armored dorsal plates, four articulated curls, opposed thumb, short angled cuff
design.geometry: 26 named cuboids per hand; no meshes, alpha cutouts, or noisy stacked micro-layers

coordinateSpace: Minecraft item model units; 16 units per item block, no display transform

directions.left: exact X reflection around x=8; same grip origin and muzzle sign

gripClearance.test: All transformed element AABBs miss the core for all Y.
gripClearance.limit: Larger grips, trigger guards and weapon bodies require master contact adjustment.

integration.nativeItemCenter: Vanilla item geometry may subtract 0.5 block; [8,8,8] then maps to local zero.
integration.masterOwns: Item registration, graph overlays, weapon anchors, camera transforms and reload motion.
integration.displayScale: Inherits each weapon's display scale in the master graph; base gloves add no scale.
integration.skinPolicy: Opaque authored gloves; no player skin sampling or promise.

texture.uvUnits: 0..16; reversed ranges intentional for mirrored hand

preview.renderer: stdlib textured triangle rasterizer, orthographic Z buffer
preview.testGrip: Preview-only cyan 1.1 X 1.3 guide, not emitted into glove models.

nativeChecksNeeded: Register/load both item models and resolve texture in the master's pack.
Ace, Duke, Izanagi and Ammit: check hip fire, ADS/combat, trigger and sight occlusion.
Check reload phases and support-hand movement with inherited per-weapon display scale.
Check centered-anchor scale/rotation and left mirror in the native renderer.
Briefly inspect 10-20 displayed assemblies for visible artifacts or stutter.
